style: 清晰、温和、有自信的产品介绍旁白，语速自然流畅偏快，节奏干净利落，句间停顿简短

lines: c1
你在聊天里，交给助手一件慢活。
You hand your assistant a slow job in chat.
c2
它说“好的”，然后——就再也没有声音了。
It says “Sure”… and then goes silent.
p1
派出去的子代理，两眼一抹黑；
Subagents set off knowing nothing;
p2
卡住了，就原地打转；
when they get stuck, they go in circles;
p3
说“做完了”，全凭自报；
“Done” is only their word for it;
p4
结果撞上你的新消息，就漏报了；
a result that lands with your new message never reaches you;
p5
网关一重启，前因后果，全都丢了。
and a gateway restart wipes out the whole story.
t1
Hermes Proactive Agent，让聊天里的助手，像一位靠谱的秘书那样做事：
Hermes Proactive Agent makes your chat assistant work like a reliable secretary:
t2
慢活交给后台的子代理，它自己，随时在线。
slow work goes to background subagents, and the assistant stays reachable.
a1
每一轮对话，都有时间预算。
Every turn has a time budget.
a2
满六十秒，提醒助手先回复你，或者把剩下的活派出去；
At 60 seconds, the assistant is reminded to answer you or hand off the rest;
a3
满一百二十秒，这一轮就暂停改文件、跑命令。
at 120 seconds, editing files and running commands pause for that turn.
a4
终端命令跑满三十秒，自动转入后台：仍在运行，并非失败。
A terminal command still running after 30 seconds moves to the background: still running, not failed.
b1
派活之前，插件先把关：交代太单薄，退回一次。
Before a handoff, the plugin checks it: a thin brief is sent back once.
b2
放行的任务，自动附上一份背景材料：
Every handoff that goes through gets a briefing attached:
b3
你最近六条消息的原话、你的记忆文件、正在运行的其他子代理、上一个没做完的任务记录，
your last six messages word for word, your memory files, other running subagents, the record of unfinished work,
b4
还有做事规矩，和统一的回报格式。
plus working rules and one report format.
d1
同一个步骤，拿到同样的结果：第三次警告，第五次叫停。
Same step, same result: a warning the 3rd time, a stop the 5th.
d2
遇到不该它拍板的选择，它不瞎猜，带着问题和选项回来。
Facing a choice that isn’t its to make, it doesn’t guess: it comes back with a question and options.
d3
能定的，助手自己定；该你拿主意的，助手来问你。
The assistant settles what it can, and asks you what only you can decide.
e1
子代理说完成了？助手先看证据，再向你报喜。
A subagent says it’s done? The assistant checks the evidence before telling you.
e2
后台结果撞上你的新消息，会一直标着“尚未告知”，直到真正转达给你。
A result that collides with your new message stays marked “unreported” until it really reaches you.
e3
每个任务都记进 SQLite 账本；网关重启了，也知道哪些任务中断、动过哪些文件。
Every task goes into a SQLite ledger; after a gateway restart, it knows what was cut off and which files it touched.
h1
还是开头那件慢活。这一次，活交给后台的子代理，助手一直在线；
The same slow job as before. This time the work goes to background subagents and the assistant stays reachable;
h2
结果核实过，才交到你手上。
the result reaches you only after it has been checked.
f1
这一切，都由普通代码完成：零模型调用，只走公开接口，只跟助手说话。
All of it is plain code: no model calls, public interfaces only, and it talks only to the assistant.
g1
两行命令装上它。在 GitHub 搜索 Hermes Proactive Agent，让你的助手，随时在线。
Two commands to install. Search “Hermes Proactive Agent” on GitHub, and keep your assistant reachable.
